text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, perfect timing. I was just hoping to 
let you know about an upcoming program 
McQueen-san will be appearing on in a 
kimono.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I was actually the one who dressed her. I 
was particularly particular about the 
collar— adjusting it millimeter by 
millimeter so it was neither too loose nor 
too tight.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Disarray is negligence; dressing properly 
is the bare minimum. Only by going above 
and beyond will one truly earn respect.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in knowing that anyone who 
watches the show will discover a whole new 
charming side to McQueen-san.
